snippet.title: Project EVILBANE – Official Reveal Trailer | Tokyo Game Show 2025
snippet.description:
Project EVILBANE follows a hardened team of apocalyptic survivors who have sworn to avenge their ruined world.

You can enter the battlefield solo or in a party of up to four players, taking on various missions and fighting powerful bosses.

Join the battle to triumph over the Archdemon's forces and save humanity!
